in_sanskrit.name: Ajahar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajahar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ajahar is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'conqueror' or 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are known for their bravery and power.
